title: Kanban board
description: Full-bleed fill board: Droppable columns, Sortable cards, sibling JSON watch. Status lives in the file, not a host ledger.
antiPatterns: WorldStage for a one-screen board (use Stack fill)
host task ledger, scheduler, or board domain
inventing methodology tabs for a board
agentPrompt: Freeform composition. Root in Stack fill so the preview drops the reading measure. Each column is a Droppable; cards in a Sortable. Cross-column moves arrive at the target Sortable.onDropItem(itemId, index) — do one write there; do not also mutate from the source onReorder. Persist board.json with useCanvasFile and watch it so other windows stay in sync. Columns and cards are sibling data — Pier is not a task ledger. Rewrite every user-visible string into the user's language. See templates/kanban.canvas.tsx and .pier/canvases/kanban/.
